Yemen Conflict Intensifies with Hundreds Reported Dead

Intense fighting between Houthi rebels and Yemeni army forces in southwest Yemen has resulted in a significant death toll, with reports indicating over 300 people killed and 84 government troops dead. The conflict, which has seen fierce clashes over four days, has also led to hundreds of families fleeing their homes. The violence marks the deadliest period since a 2022 truce collapsed.
